tagline.zh: SwiftUI .spring(response:dampingFraction:blendDuration:) 两参数弹簧:response 是刚度的时间尺度(秒),dampingFraction 是相对临界阻尼的比例——iOS 原生手感的来源。
tagline.en: SwiftUI's .spring(response:dampingFraction:blendDuration:) two-parameter spring: response is the time-scale of stiffness (seconds), dampingFraction the ratio of critical damping — the source of iOS' native feel.

origin.zh: Apple DocC 官方默认值:response = 0.5s、dampingFraction = 0.825、blendDuration = 0(经官方文档 JSON 数据接口核实,调研 02§A11 与 04§1.3B 双源一致);预设族 bouncy/snappy/smooth 官方定义为 duration 0.5s + 基础 bounce 0.3/0.15/0(调研 02§A13)。
origin.en: Apple DocC official defaults: response = 0.5s, dampingFraction = 0.825, blendDuration = 0 (verified via the official docs JSON data endpoint; research 02 §A11 and 04 §1.3B agree); the preset family bouncy/snappy/smooth is officially defined as duration 0.5s + base bounce 0.3/0.15/0 (research 02 §A13).

effect.zh: 弹簧刚度的时间尺度,以近似时长(秒)表达(Apple 原文:『response 是以近似时长表达的刚度』,0 表示无限刚、适合交互驱动)。官方默认 0.5s(Apple DocC)。调大更慢更黏;调小更急促,趋近 interactiveSpring 的交互区间。
effect.en: The time-scale of the spring's stiffness, expressed as an approximate duration in seconds (Apple: 'response is... the stiffness expressed as an approximate duration'; 0 means infinitely stiff, suited to interactive driving). Official default 0.5s (Apple DocC). Higher = slower and stickier; lower = snappier, approaching interactiveSpring territory.

effect.zh: 相对临界阻尼所需阻尼量的比例(Apple 原文:『dampingFraction 是相对临界阻尼所需阻尼量的比例』)。官方默认 0.825:略欠阻尼,到位时带一丝回弹。1=临界阻尼无回弹;<1 回弹随数值减小而增多;<0.5 明显振荡;>1 过阻尼,缓慢爬向目标。
effect.en: The fraction of the damping needed for critical damping (Apple: 'dampingFraction is... the fraction of the amount of damping needed to achieve critical damping'). Official default 0.825: slightly under-damped, with a hint of overshoot on arrival. 1 = critically damped, no bounce; below 1 the bounce grows as the value drops; under 0.5 oscillates visibly; above 1 overdamped, crawling to the target.

effect.zh: Apple 弹簧预设族,官方定义均为 duration 0.5s + 基础 bounce:bouncy=0.3、snappy=0.15、smooth=0(Apple DocC,调研 02§A13)。demo 上轨按此官方定义以 Motion 的 duration+bounce 弹簧驱动,与下轨 response/dampingFraction 自定义弹簧同跑对照。默认选中 snappy 是演示选择,并非官方『默认预设』。
effect.en: Apple's spring preset family, officially defined as duration 0.5s + base bounce: bouncy = 0.3, snappy = 0.15, smooth = 0 (Apple DocC, research 02 §A13). The demo's top lane drives it with Motion's duration+bounce spring exactly per that definition, racing the bottom lane's custom response/dampingFraction spring. Defaulting to snappy is a demo choice, not an official 'default preset'.

note.zh: 原生 API 属 SwiftUI(iOS 13+);Web 端等价物由 Motion(前 Framer Motion)的物理弹簧承载——两套参数体系为当前主流(调研 04§1.3)。demo 为 Web 演示:依赖 JS 执行,禁用 JS 时元素停在初始位置。
note.en: The native API belongs to SwiftUI (iOS 13+); the Web-side equivalent rides on Motion's (formerly Framer Motion) physics springs — the two mainstream spring parameter systems (research 04 §1.3). The demo is a Web rendition: it requires JS, and elements stay at their initial position without it.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 时直出终态(demo 以 useReducedMotion 检测并跳过动画);动效不作传达关键信息的唯一手段(HIG 动效原则);连续 spring 动画接力会保留速度——打断不是重置(调研 04§1.3B)。
fallback.en: Output the final state directly under prefers-reduced-motion (the demo detects via useReducedMotion and skips animation); motion is never the sole carrier of key information (HIG motion principles); consecutive spring animations keep their velocity — interruption is not a reset (research 04 §1.3B).

use.zh: iOS 原生手感的跨端复刻:用 response/dampingFraction 对齐系统控件
use.en: Cross-platform replication of iOS' native feel: match system controls via response/dampingFraction

use.zh: 默认 0.5s/0.825 适合大多数浮层、卡片与切换;想要更利落先调小 response
use.en: The 0.5s/0.825 default suits most overlays, cards and toggles; lower response first for snappier feel

use.zh: 预设族选型:回弹选 bouncy、通用交互选 snappy、无回弹选 smooth(官方定义见参数说明)
use.en: Preset picking: bouncy for bounce, snappy for general interaction, smooth for none (official definitions in the param note)

use.zh: 交互驱动的跟手动画:response 调小(趋近 0=无限刚),Apple 明示 0 适合交互驱动
use.en: Interactive, hand-following animation: lower response (0 = infinitely stiff, explicitly recommended for interactive driving)

avoid.zh: 进度条等连续量——不该有回弹(参考 motion 弹簧条目同款告诫)
avoid.en: Continuous quantities like progress bars — no bounce belongs there (same caveat as the Motion spring entry)

avoid.zh: Web 端把 response/dampingFraction 当官方互换参数直接传给 Motion——两者参数体系不同,必须换算
avoid.en: Passing response/dampingFraction straight into Motion on the Web as if interchangeable — the parameter systems differ and must be converted

avoid.zh: 高频小控件(checkbox 等)加弹簧——HIG:高频交互避免加动效(调研 04§2.1)
avoid.en: Springs on high-frequency small controls (checkboxes etc.) — Apple HIG: avoid motion on frequent interactions (research 04 §2.1)

avoid.zh: 把预设(bouncy/snappy/smooth)与 response/dampingFraction 混为一谈——预设的官方定义是 duration+bounce 体系
avoid.en: Conflating the presets (bouncy/snappy/smooth) with response/dampingFraction — the presets are officially defined in the duration+bounce system

a11y.zh: 弹簧属位移类动效,是前庭障碍的常见触发源:必须响应 prefers-reduced-motion(demo 直出终态);不要让『等弹簧播完』成为操作前置条件(HIG:动效可取消);回弹幅度(dampingFraction 调小)会放大位移不适,弱跌用户与 0.2Hz 振荡敏感人群尤甚(调研 04§1.6/§6)。
a11y.en: Springs are displacement motion — a common vestibular trigger: they must honor prefers-reduced-motion (the demo outputs the final state directly); never make users wait out a spring (HIG: motion is cancellable); stronger bounce (lower dampingFraction) amplifies displacement discomfort, especially for motion-sensitive users (research 04 §1.6/§6).

goal.zh: 用 Motion 的物理弹簧复刻 SwiftUI .spring(response:dampingFraction:) 手感:response/dampingFraction 经二阶阻尼谐振子等价换算为 stiffness/damping(mass=1)驱动下轨,上轨按 Apple 官方预设定义(duration 0.5s + bounce 0.3/0.15/0)驱动,两轨同跑对照。
goal.en: Replicate SwiftUI's .spring(response:dampingFraction:) feel with Motion's physics spring: convert response/dampingFraction into stiffness/damping via the damped-oscillator equivalence (mass=1) for the bottom lane, and drive the top lane exactly per Apple's preset definitions (duration 0.5s + bounce 0.3/0.15/0), racing both lanes together.

acceptance.zh: response/dampingFraction 使用快照值;换算 stiffness = (2π/response)²、damping = 4π·dampingFraction/response,mass 固定 1
acceptance.en: Use the response/dampingFraction snapshot; convert stiffness = (2π/response)², damping = 4π·dampingFraction/response, with mass fixed at 1

acceptance.zh: 预设轨严格按官方定义:duration 0.5s + bounce(bouncy 0.3 / snappy 0.15 / smooth 0)
acceptance.en: The preset lane follows Apple's official definitions exactly: duration 0.5s + bounce (bouncy 0.3 / snappy 0.15 / smooth 0)

acceptance.zh: 两轨同时出发、同目标,便于对照手感差异
acceptance.en: Both lanes launch together toward the same target so the feel difference is directly comparable

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时跳过动画直出终态
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, skip animation and output the final state directly
